raw.query: WITH p90_best AS (SELECT window_name, MIN(min_provisioned_ws) AS best_ws FROM provenance.v_closedloop_frontier WHERE quantile='p90' AND window_name != 'aggregate' AND all_feasible GROUP BY window_name), c8_denom AS (SELECT window_name, denominator_worker_seconds AS c8_ws FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE denominator_kind='deployable_static_c8' AND is_current=true AND policy='forecast' AND quantile='p90' GROUP BY window_name, denominator_worker_seconds) SELECT p.window_name, p.best_ws, c.c8_ws, p.best_ws / c.c8_ws AS ratio FROM p90_best p JOIN c8_denom c USING (window_name) ORDER BY p.window_name;
